label: Two finite, universally accessible, explanation-sound models separate the…, by Model-construction
meaning: Construct two explicit Bool-world/Bool-individual models with universal accessibility and truthful explanation attributions: one satisfies existence-PSR and has a necessary individual, while not every existent has a distinct existing cause; the other satisfies contingent-only PSR, has a contingent and a necessary individual at world false, and fails existence-PSR. The theorem exposes only these properties; further features of the witnesses (no causes at all, intrinsic reasons, the necessary individual being the unexplained one) are not certified by its type. No metaphysical PSR premise is adopted.
